code_lines: ﻿/*GENERA BASE DE SALIDA PARA ARCHIVO NOTA*/

SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T4.N_SCN AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T3.C_SI AS C_SI_C_AGENTE,T3.N_SI AS N_SI_C_AGENTE,T3.C_SI_publ AS C_SI_publ_C_AGENTE,
T3.N_SI_publ AS N_SI_publ_C_AGENTE, T3.C_SI_SCN AS C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE, T3.N_SI_SCN AS N_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, SUM(T1.DATO)/1000 AS DATO,
T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1 AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1 AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN
GROUP BY CALCULATED MONEDA, T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,T2.C_SI_publ,T2.N_SI_publ,T2.C_SI_SCN,T2.N_SI_SCN,T1.C_SCN,T4.N_SCN,T3.C_SI,T3.N_SI,T3.C_SI_publ,
T3.N_SI_publ, T3.C_SI_SCN, T3.N_SI_SCN, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA,T2.C_SI_SCN_N1, T2.N_SI_SCN_N1, T4.C_SCN_N1,T4.N_SCN_N1,T5.C_Cuenta_SCN, T5.N_Cuenta_SCN;
SELECT DISTINCT 'AÑO'n,TRIM,CATS((CASE WHEN TRIM IN (1,4) THEN '31' ELSE '30' END),'-',(CASE WHEN TRIM=1 THEN '03' WHEN TRIM=2 THEN '06' WHEN TRIM=3 THEN '09' ELSE '12' END),'-',AÑO) AS FECHA,
WHERE C_SCN='B.8' AND C_ENTRADA='D' AND AÑO>=&ANIO
WHERE FUENTE = 'DI_Aj_REAJ' AND PROC='0071' AND C_ENTRADA='D' AND SECTOR IN (34,341) AND AÑO>=&ANIO
DROP TABLE DEUDA_HOLDING, AHORRO_PRE_0, AHORRO_PRE_1, PERIODO ;
proc sql; create table deuda_hog_dpf as /*dede 2022 en adelante*/
and (t2.tipo_registro_20='item' or t2.c_instrumento_ALB<>'')  and t2.c_item_nuevo not in (170000100,149500100,149700100,149600100,143150100,143250100,265000100) and t2.Partida=1
and t2.c_si='511' and (t2.c_instrumento_ALB contains '5' or t2.c_instrumento_ALB contains '4' or t2.c_instrumento_ALB contains '9') and t1.mes in (3,6,9,12))
proc sql; create table deuda_hog_dpf_2 as /*desde 2017 a 2021*/

select t1.año,t1.mes,t2.rubro,t2.glosa_rubro,t2.linea,t2.glosa_linea,t2.c_item_nuevo,t2.glosa_item_nuevo,t2.c_instrumento_ALB,put(t2.c_si,char3.) as C_CAGENTE, sum(t1.dato)/1000000 as DATO,t1.t_estado

where (t1.c_cuenta=t2.c_item_nuevo and t1.moneda=t2.moneda and t2.Partida in (1) and  t2.c_si=511 and (t2.c_instrumento_ALB contains '5' or t2.c_instrumento_ALB contains '4' or t2.c_instrumento_ALB contains '9')
and t1.mes in (3,6,9,12)) and año>=2017 and t2.rubro=1304 and t2.c_item_nuevo not in (1304102)
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DEUDA_HIPOTECARIA AS /*2022 en adelante*/
SELECT T1.AÑO, T1.mes/3 as TRIM,'Deuda hipotecaria' as SERIE,sum(t1.dato) AS DATO,TODAY() FORMAT=DATE. AS VERSION
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DEUDA_HIPOTECARIA_2 AS /*2017 a 2022*/
SELECT T1.AÑO, T1.mes/3 as TRIM,'Deuda hipotecaria' as SERIE,sum(t1.dato) AS DATO,TODAY() FORMAT=DATE. AS VERSION
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DEUDA_BANCARIA_T AS /*deuda total bancaria*/
SELECT AÑO,TRIM,'Deuda bancaria' as SERIE,SUM(DATO) AS DATO,TODAY() FORMAT=DATE. AS VERSION
WHERE AÑO>=2017 AND SECTOR=511 AND C_CAGENTE='321' AND C_SCN IN ('AF.41','AF.42') AND C_CUENTA='Bce Final' AND C_ENTRADA='H'
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DEUDA_CONSUMO AS /*deuda consumo bancaria*/
SELECT AÑO,TRIM,'Deuda bancaria' as SERIE,SUM(CASE WHEN SERIE='Deuda hipoteca' THEN DATO*-1 ELSE DATO END) AS DATO,VERSION
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DEUDA_TOT_HH AS /*deuda total hogares*/
SELECT AÑO,TRIM,'Deuda otra' as SERIE,SUM(DATO) AS DATO,TODAY() FORMAT=DATE. AS VERSION
WHERE AÑO>=2017 AND SECTOR=511 AND C_CUENTA='Bce Final' AND C_ENTRADA='H' AND C_SCN NOT IN ('B.90')
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DEUDA_RESTO AS /*deuda resto no bancos*/
SELECT AÑO,TRIM,'Deuda otra' as SERIE,SUM(CASE WHEN SERIE='Deuda otra' THEN DATO ELSE DATO*-1 END) AS DATO,VERSION
DATA DEUDA_HOGARES_; SET DEUDA_HIPOTECARIA DEUDA_CONSUMO DEUDA_RESTO;RUN;
proc sql; drop table DEUDA_HIPOTECARIA, DEUDA_CONSUMO, DEUDA_RESTO,DEUDA_BANCARIA_T,DEUDA_BANCARIA_T2,DEUDA_TOT_HH,deuda_hog_dpf,deuda_hog_dpf_2,DEUDA_HIPOTECARIA_2;quit;
/*OFERENTES DE CRÉDITO NO BANCARIO. Miles de millones de pesos*/
SELECT T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, 'OCNB' AS Serie,T1.SECTOR,T2.N_SI,SUM(T1.DATO)/1000 AS DATO
WHERE 	T1.AÑO>=&ANIO AND T1.SECTOR=322 AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN IN ('AF.41','AF.42') AND T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Final' and t1.fuente='CI'
SELECT T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, 'OCNB' AS Serie,332 as SECTOR,'Leasing y factoring' as N_SI,SUM(T1.DATO)/1000 AS DATO
WHERE 	T1.AÑO>=&ANIO AND T1.SECTOR in (3321,3322,33211,33212,33221,33222) AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN IN ('AF.41','AF.42','AF.7') AND T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Final' and t1.fuente='CI'
SELECT T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM, 'OCNB' AS Serie,332 as SECTOR,'Tarjetas comerciales' as N_SI,SUM(T1.DATO)/1000 AS DATO
WHERE 	T1.AÑO>=&ANIO AND T1.SECTOR in (335,334) AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN IN ('AF.7') AND T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Final' and t1.fuente='CI' and t1.c_cagente="511"
data OCNF; set OCNB_322 OCNB_T OCNB_LF ;run;
proc sql; drop table OCNB_322, OCNB_T, OCNB_LF;quit;
